from devtools.resources.filesystem import TextCodec,TextDecodingError,TextEncodingError
from devtools.core.paths import resolve_path
codec=TextCodec();path=resolve_path(Path.cwd()/"sample.txt")
try: decoded=codec.decode(path,b"a\xffb",errors="replace")
except TypeError as e: raise AssertionError("explicit codec error policies not supported") from e
assert decoded.content=="a\ufffdb" and decoded.byte_size==3 and decoded.encoding=="utf-8"
assert codec.decode(path,b"a\xffb",errors="ignore").content=="ab"
assert codec.decode(path,b"a\xffb",errors="backslashreplace").content==r"a\xffb"
assert codec.decode(path,b"a\r\nb\n",errors="strict").content=="a\r\nb\n"
file=codec.decode(path,"aéz".encode())
assert codec.encode(file,encoding="ascii",errors="ignore")==b"az"
assert codec.encode(file,encoding="ascii",errors="replace")==b"a?z"
assert codec.encode(file,encoding="ascii",errors="backslashreplace")==b"a\\xe9z"
assert codec.encode(file)=="aéz".encode()
for direction,error in (("decode",TextDecodingError),("encode",TextEncodingError)):
 for policy in ("strict","no-such-handler"):
  try:
   codec.decode(path,b"\xff",errors=policy) if direction=="decode" else codec.encode(file,encoding="ascii",errors=policy)
  except error as e: assert e.__cause__ is not None
  else: raise AssertionError("domain exception compatibility lost")
assert file.content=="aéz" and file.encoding=="utf-8"
print("13 text codec policy and compatibility checks passed")
